registry_info.description: Tools of the hand's inventory (commons/data/inventory/items.json) that are not things to leave in the world: the rubber takes one placed thing back; the pin freezes a placed thing where it is or releases it.

inventory_rubber.name: Rubber
inventory_rubber.description: An eraser: a pink block with a dark band, 12 cm. The inventory's tool for taking one placed thing back - worn as a miniature on the right hand, the trigger on a thing the hand placed removes it, on a tape strip removes the strip, on the world nothing. Not a thing to place.

inventory_pin.name: Pin
inventory_pin.description: A push pin: a red head on a steel shaft, 4.5 cm. The inventory's tool for Garry's Mod's physgun click - worn as a miniature on the right hand, the trigger on a thing the hand placed freezes it where it is (mid-air included), on a frozen one releases it to be a body again. Not a thing to place.
